summary.text: Kimberly-Ann Collins is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 77, an office she has held since January 2021, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She holds a public health sciences degree from the University of Missouri at Kansas City.

paragraphs.text: Kimberly-Ann Collins was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and earned a B.S. in public health sciences from the University of Missouri at Kansas City in 2015.
Ballotpedia says her career experience includes working with PotBangerz, RedBike and City Hope STL, and that she has served with the Ville Collaborative and with Yeatman Liddell Full Service School.
Collins assumed office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Steve Roberts, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignment is the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee.
